translations.web: I will bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.
translations.bsb: I will bless the LORD who counsels me; even at night my conscience instructs me.
translations.kjv: I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.
translations.asv: I will bless Jehovah, who hath given me counsel; Yea, my heart instructeth me in the night seasons.
